name: Open Source Upgrade & Migration
description: Upgrade or migrate an open-source application using its own migration notes.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
See the application layout before changing it.
Find the code, docs, or config the task names.
Read a readme, changelog, or spec.
Find official documentation for this software.
Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.
See upstream history versus local commits.

validation.rule: The upgrade followed migration notes that were read. Local modifications were identified before the upgrade.
